name: Luggage
question: Which carry-on matches your weight, construction and wheel preferences?

filters.label: Empty weight
filters.hint: Less bag weight leaves more room for your belongings.
filters.edge_case: Use empty weight; exclude packed weight.

filters.label: Construction
filters.hint: Choose a hard shell or soft fabric construction.
filters.edge_case: Keep exact manufacturer wording in the record. Group construction editorially; do not infer durability or protection.

filters.label: Wheel mechanism
filters.hint: Choose a spinner or a two-wheel rolling design.
filters.edge_case: Group the manufacturer’s stated wheel mechanism. Do not confuse individual tires with wheel assemblies.

display_fields.label: Overall size with wheels and handles (H × W × D)
display_fields.hint: Unexpanded overall dimensions, when the measurement definition is verified.
display_fields.edge_case: Use unexpanded H × W × D including wheels and handles. Keep conflicting or unverified measurement definitions out of benchmarks.

explainer.title: Why dimensions do not guarantee airline acceptance
explainer.text: Brands may publish case size, overall size or expanded size. These are different measurements. The dimensions shown here include wheels and handles only when confirmed, in height × width × depth order. Check your carrier directly; measurements alone do not guarantee acceptance.

notice: Curated US-market starter catalog. Manufacturer pages checked 2026-11-07. Not comprehensive.
notes: Construction and wheel groups are editorial; cards retain the manufacturer’s wording. Dimensions are display-only. Price is not tracked.
